mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, the weather is 38 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman Park. While the ISS will pass overhead tonight, we will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

For city news, candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available. If you are planning to run, please note that all forms must be submitted to the City Clerk by 5 PM on January 5. Regarding property taxes, bills will be mailed by December 15, and you have until January 31 to pay your first installment.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or the ART House 360 Thursday night festivities. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run, celebrate 50 years of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or visit the Crafty Fair at ART House 360.
In the weekly recap for November 1 through 15, our officers handled a variety of calls including a notable incident involving the recovery of a stolen vehicle that occurred on November 1.
The Culver's in Verona is closed today. We look forward to tomorrow, when the flavor of the day will be Snickers Swirl. The store will open tomorrow at 10 AM.
